acceptance: An advisory job runs on site PRs, compares against the deployed artifact, and uploads diffs without failing ci
The job is not in the ci aggregate's needs
context:
Split out of site-split-21 (step 4, advisory visual regression) on 2026-10-09: the comparison needs a deployed artifact and receipts, which the deploy plane (site-split-23) provides. S1 (benchbox-site PR #1) shipped the rest of item 21.
2026-10-09: implemented in benchbox-site PR #10, merged 07d5225. .github/workflows/visual.yml (not in ci needs); `npm run deploy -- deployed` finds the newest recorded receipt; the PR is built from the receipt's bundle (bundle:fetch SITE_INPUTS_CORE_SHA + SITE_INPUTS_DIGEST); scripts/visual-diff.mjs writes the job summary and the visual-diff artifact; the capture spec freezes the landing ticker (two captures of one build are now byte-identical); core baseline download scripts removed. PR #10's own run took the no-receipt path (run 37944181755). Local dry run of the compare path with core preview 37940126973 as the stand-in deployed tree: 20 unchanged, 4 changed (landing release pill, an allowlisted intended difference).
Remaining: the first acceptance line needs a real receipt. Finish after site-split-30's first rehearsal deploy: open or re-run a site PR and confirm the job downloads site-artifact-<receipt run>, captures both trees and uploads visual-diff.
description:
Owner decision D8: visual regression in the site repo is advisory, not part of the required `ci` aggregate.

1. Add a site CI job that captures the public pages from the PR build (the Explorer's `test:e2e:public-site` capture spec is the starting point) and compares them with captures of the currently deployed artifact, found through the newest deploy receipt.
2. Report differences as a job summary and an uploaded diff artifact; never fail `ci` on them.
3. Port or drop `explorer/scripts/download-public-site-visual-baseline.mjs`, which expects core's baseline artifacts.
